subject: Invoice recipient reassignment + tax form clarification for Renewal Upsell
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@orbisanalytics.com>, accounts-payable@orbisanalytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice recipient reassignment + tax form clarification for Renewal Upsell

Hi Sam / AP team,

Thanks again for the commitment increase — excited to get Orbis on the larger Reserved plan. A couple of quick billing items we need to confirm before we push the SOW to finance and issue the upgraded invoice: 

- Invoice recipient: you mentioned last week that billing should go to a local entity ("Orbis Analytics Ltd"). Please confirm the exact legal name, billing address, and the email the invoice should be sent to (we currently have billing@orbisanalytics.com on file).
- PO: will you be issuing a separate PO for the capacity top-up? If so, can you share the PO number to include on the invoice?
- Tax form: do you require a W-9 (US payor) or a W-8BEN-E (non-US entity)? If you can state which form you need on record, we will route the right packet to finance.
- Net terms: I understand Finance asked about switching to Net60 for this renewal. Is Net60 confirmed from your side, or do we need to stick to Net30?

Attaching the current SOW draft for reference. If you confirm the above, Marissa will generate the invoice to the correct entity and include the PO.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood_SOW_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@orbisanalytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@orbisanalytics.com, Rachel Park <rachel.park@orbisanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice recipient reassignment + tax form clarification for Renewal Upsell

Hi Camila — thanks for the note. Confirming details from our end: 

- Legal payee: "Orbis Analytics Ltd" (Ireland HQ). Billing address: 12 Merrion Square, Dublin 2, D02 ABC1, Ireland. Please send the invoice to billing@orbisanalytics.com and cc: rachel.park@orbisanalytics.com.
- PO: Yes — procurement will issue PO ORB-2027-1109 for the upsell top-up. We'll attach it to the AP email once signed.
- Tax form: since the payee is an Irish entity, AP requires a signed W-8BEN-E on file for Redwood to accept Net60. If there are any local entity certificates or VAT numbers you need, let us know and we'll share.
- Net terms: Procurement is OK with Net60 for this order.

I'll follow up with AP to push the PO through. Attaching a short PO request note from our procurement team.

Thanks,
Sam
Head of Platform Ops
Orbis Analytics
[attachment: Orbis_PO_Request_20270712.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@orbisanalytics.com>, accounts-payable@orbisanalytics.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice recipient reassignment + tax form clarification for Renewal Upsell

Hi Sam — perfect, thanks for confirming. Marissa / Finance team (cc'd) — can you take the following actions?

1) Prepare an invoice addressed to: Orbis Analytics Ltd, 12 Merrion Square, Dublin 2, D02 ABC1, Ireland. Send to billing@orbisanalytics.com and cc rachel.park@orbisanalytics.com.
2) Include PO ORB-2027-1109 on the invoice once we receive the signed PO.
3) Switch terms to Net60 per Sam's confirmation.
4) Request a completed W-8BEN-E from Orbis before finalizing the Net60 term in our system (AP asked that the W-8 be on file to justify the tax status).

Sam — we can accept the W-8BEN-E via email to invoices@redwood.com or you can upload to the secure link in the DocuSign packet; whichever is easiest for your AP. Once Marissa has the invoice draft I'll share it with you for sign-off.

Looping in Vivek to keep the account handoff smooth on the upsell.

Best,
Camila
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Invoice recipient reassignment + tax form clarification for Renewal Upsell

Thanks — I will draft the invoice and the updated billing packet. Checklist for internal ops: 

- Draft invoice to "Orbis Analytics Ltd" with PO line for ORB-2027-1109; include SOW reference RDW-2345-Upsell.
- Set payment terms to Net60 in the invoice metadata but mark the order as "Pending W-8 on file" to prevent automated Net60 billing until we receive the W-8BEN-E.
- Request that AP send the signed PO and the completed W-8BEN-E to invoices@redwood.com. If they prefer, we can send a secure DocuSign upload for the W-8 (I recommend DocuSign for PII).
- Include VAT note: since payee is in Ireland, include the VAT number field blank until Orbis supplies it.

Ben — can you create the DocuSign envelope with the SOW attached and a secure upload for the W-8? That will speed things up. I'll attach the invoice draft to this thread once ready.

Camila / Vivek — please confirm whether we should apply the committed discount tier from the renewal immediately or only once PO + W-8 are received. My recommendation: apply discount on the invoice draft and mark finalization contingent on PO + W-8.

Marissa Cole
Senior Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@orbisanalytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@orbisanalytics.com
Cc: Rachel Park <rachel.park@orbisanalytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0400

Next steps from our side:
- Rachel will upload W-8BEN-E by EOD Monday.
- AP will begin 30-day processing once invoice + PO + W-8 are received.
